children: Needham reiterated their Buy rating on Micron Technology's stock with a price target of $1650.00.
The price target implies an upside of 80.6% from the Oct 21 close of $913.67.
Key takeaways from the analyst note
Strong Demand in Data Center and AI Markets

: Micron Technology is positioned to benefit from increasing data center spending and the growing demand for high-bandwidth memory (HBM) solutions, particularly due to advancements in artificial intelligence and machine learning applications.

: The company has a robust future roadmap with significant developments in its 1-delta node technology, expected to improve bit density and performance, further solidifying its competitive edge in the memory market.
Across the five most recent analyst notes published on MU over the past 30 days, price targets range from $1500 to $3000.
